article.title: English to Hindi: Expressing feelings
article.description: English: 'I'm really looking forward to the weekend.' Hindi: 'मुझे सप्ताहांत का बेसब्री से इंतज़ार है।' Teaching point: 'looking forward to' has no single-word Hindi equivalent — 'बेसब्री से इंतज़ार' (eagerly waiting) captures the same excited-anticipation meaning.
